operations.name: polymarketGetTagBySlug
operations.description: Resolve a concise topical slug before market discovery. A successful tag lookup does not by itself establish relevance or market quality.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Concise candidate topic slug to validate, such as bitcoin. If it does not resolve, do not invent a tag ID.

operations.name: polymarketListRelevantMarkets
operations.description: Find candidate markets using an exact tag ID resolved by the tag operation. Keep only Bitcoin, crypto, economic, political, regulatory, liquidity, or macro markets with a material and explainable Bitcoin connection. Liquidity and volume filters are optional aids, not universal quality thresholds.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: A one-item array containing the exact numeric tag ID returned by polymarketGetTagBySlug.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Small response-size cap. Start with the narrowest useful result set.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: Whether to request closed markets. Keep false for current expectations unless the user explicitly asks for history.

parameters.name: liquidity_num_min
parameters.description: Optional adaptive minimum for the API's reported liquidity value. Do not apply a fixed universal cutoff; choose only after considering the scale and peers of the relevant market set.

parameters.name: volume_num_min
parameters.description: Optional adaptive minimum for the API's reported cumulative volume value. Do not apply a fixed universal cutoff; compare relevant candidates first.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Optional live API field used for candidate ordering.

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Sort direction for the selected order field. Use false when seeking the most liquid or highest-volume candidates.

parameters.name: related_tags
parameters.description: Optionally include markets under related tags. Keep false unless broader discovery is necessary and manually recheck relevance.

parameters.name: include_tag
parameters.description: Include tag metadata with each candidate for relevance review.

parameters.name: after_cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior keyset response. Do not invent or alter it.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketById
operations.description: Inspect one public market's question, outcomes, prices, status, activity, spread, and resolution source.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact public Polymarket market ID returned by the API.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketBySlug
operations.description: Get a prediction market by exact slug

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Exact public market slug returned by Polymarket.

operations.name: polymarketGetMarketTags
operations.description: Use tags as supporting relevance metadata, not as proof that a market is useful or Bitcoin-related.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact public Polymarket market ID returned by the API.

operations.name: getRepoContent
operations.description: Read a public directory listing or small UTF-8 text file. Pass a raw path; use '.' for the repository root. File content is decoded text, not base64.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: GitHub account or organization that owns the public repository.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Public repository name without the owner prefix.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Raw file or directory path; the server encodes it. Use '.' for the repository root. Do not percent-encode it.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA. Omit to use the repository's default branch.
